verdict.rationale: Pinecone is a vector database and retrieval platform. The evidence describes indexes, search, Assistant, inference and an MCP server, but no automations or workflows that could be versioned, reviewed or rolled back, so this axis is a category mismatch. Index backups (pinecone-docs-12) are data-protection snapshots, not automation version control, and earn no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
